messages.content: what structure makes up the middle ear

message.content:
The **middle ear** is mainly made up of the **tympanic cavity** and the **epitympanic recess**.[1][2] It also contains the three **auditory ossicles**—the **malleus**, **incus**, and **stapes**—which transmit sound vibrations.[1][2][3]

If you want, I can also list the **other structures in the middle ear** such as the Eustachian tube and middle ear muscles.
